exact_statement: For every Boolean F(X,Y) on disjoint independent uniform physical cubes, if F=sum_J chi_J(X)u_J(Y), each u_J is the sum of at most two quadratic F2 phases on disjoint affine Y cells, and all row cells partition Y, then H(S_Y|S_X)<=24 I_Y(F) and H(F)<=24 I_Y(F). The class is stable under all Y coordinate restrictions, includes every single X-coordinate restriction of distinct-label quadratic affine partitions, and any fresh Boolean Y tensor factor has F2 degree at most three. No closure under arbitrary further X collisions is asserted.
hypotheses: Boolean signs; uniform independent physical X,Y cubes
At most two disjoint affine quadratic cells per X-frequency row; cells across all rows partition Y
Entropy in bits; influence in original physical coordinates
Optional X degree at most any integer d>=1; no spectral independence assumed
contributors: A034; credit A033 for bounded F2 phase-degree baseline and A079 for earlier full-cube quadratic collision
first_unproved_line: For unrestricted further X collisions, no dimension-independent payment is proved for rows with unboundedly many affine components. The coherent entropy factor and simultaneous cancellation remain unpaid.
